adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real design concern in the diff. Looking at app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb lines 29-32, the code extracts URLs from RSS items and passes them to TopicEmbed.import(). In topic_embed.rb line 11, `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` silently returns nil for non-HTTP URLs. This means if an RSS feed has relative links or non-HTTP Atom IDs, those entries are silently skipped without logging or error handling. While this is intentional filtering (only HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported), the silent failure without any logging or notification could make debugging feed import issues difficult. This is a legitimate design/robustness concern rather than a bug, as the behavior is intentional but the lack of feedback is problematic for operations.
